message.content: Hai! Maaf, saya tidak memiliki akses ke sistem inventaris atau status pesanan. Untuk memastikan apakah pakaian tersebut sudah siap, silakan hubungi layanan pelanggan kami atau cek status pesanan melalui akun Anda di situs web kami. Terima kasih!

We have a tool for user authentication. But we don't need to authenticate. There's no mention of needing to log in. So we can respond with a friendly answer. Possibly we should ask for clarification? The user might be asking about a product status. We can respond: "Maaf, saya tidak dapat memeriksa status produk. Silakan hubungi layanan pelanggan." Or we can ask for more details. Let's respond politely.
